name: Xiaomi Mi TV 5 Pro 65-inch (China)
summary: Xiaomi Mi TV 5 Pro 65-inch (China) ships with telemetry, push and cloud control, plus ads. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with backup and undo.
intro: This China-market Xiaomi TV ships with telemetry, push and cloud-control services, ads and promoted content on PatchWall, and a lot of background services and preloaded apps. It also has a Chinese voice assistant and Mi Home. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

On this firmware the old PatchWall home screen must stay on, because switching it off leaves a black screen. TidyTV sets the new home screen as preferred instead, and that survives a reboot. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: PatchWall, the stock home, which stays on
notes: Do not switch off the stock home. Without it the TV shows a black screen.
Network debugging closes on every reboot and has to be turned back on.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Xiaomi Mi TV 5 Pro 65-inch?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Will I see the old PatchWall home screen?
faq.a: No. It stays on in the background, but the new home screen is set as preferred, so PatchWall is never shown.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Xiaomi Mi TV 5 Pro 65-inch?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
